theorem PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.finite_conversion.{u_3} {κ : Type u_3} [DecidableEq κ] (G : Finset κ)
  (E : Finset (Finset κ)) (p : κ → Real) (c : Finset κ → Real)
  (hE : ∀ (e : Finset κ), Membership.mem E e → And (LE.le e G) (Eq (Finset.card e) 2))
  (hp : ∀ (i : κ), Membership.mem G i → And (LE.le 0 (p i)) (LE.le (p i) 1)) (P : Real) (hP : LE.le 0 P)
  (hcap : ∀ (i : κ), Membership.mem G i → LE.le (p i) P) :

    (tsum fun k =>

          (DFunLike.coe (AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff (PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.finiteReference G E p c)) k)
          (PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.quadraticMass (Finset.sum G fun i => p i)
            (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul 2 (Finset.sum E fun e => c e)) (Finset.sum G fun i => HPow.hPow (p i) 2)) k)))

      (HAdd.hAdd

            LE.le (abs (HSub.hSub (↑L) (HDiv.hDiv (Real.log ↑N) (Real.log 2)))) C →

                        (PaperP1Registry.V2.StoppingReconstruction.secondCumulant N L) k)))

surface.module_doc:
# P1 V2: Stopping, heterogeneous conversion and complete-law reconstruction

Selected statements cover main article results 4.1–4.2,5.1–5.3. Literal definitions specify
the independent prime-sign model, exact observables, reference laws and error
norms. Parameters and thresholds retain their printed order. The companion
supplies substantive proofs through the parent development in this repository.
The corresponding six-dossier coverage map records each complete clause bundle.
Only the selected Challenge theorem proofs are deliberate statement holes;
the Solution and its bridge proofs contain no placeholders.
Selected model foundations are adapted through P1 from Paper C, commit
b9fa9ba490f201b408a302a86f1594ee620b228b, Apache-2.0; see docs/PAPER_C_REUSE.md.
